# ezghcloud_warehouse (Resource)

A managed ClickHouse warehouse in a subnet of your VPC: 1 to 8 shards, each with 1 to 3 replicas. Clients connect over HTTPS and the native protocol with TLS, with a username and password. It comes with the database default and the user app, whose password is in a Secret (app_secret_id). This resource never creates, changes or deletes a database or a user: use ezghcloud_warehouse_database and ezghcloud_warehouse_user. Destroying it deletes the warehouse, every database and table in it, its backups and its users' Secrets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Two shards with two replicas each. Shards and replicas grow in place.
resource "ezghcloud_warehouse" "example" {
  project_id       = ezghcloud_project.example.id
  name             = "analytics"
  engine_version   = "26.8"
  shards           = 2
  replicas         = 2
  instance_type    = "gp-1.large"
  storage_size_gib = 500
  subnet_id        = ezghcloud_subnet.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `engine_version` (String) ClickHouse LTS version, 26.3 or 26.8. A newer version upgrades in place, one node at a time (one-way); an older one is refused at plan.
- `instance_type` (String) Every node's instance type, with at least 8 GiB of memory. Changes in place, one replica of each shard at a time.
- `name` (String) Warehouse name. Changes in place.
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier. Changing it replaces the warehouse.
- `storage_size_gib` (Number) Each node's storage in GiB, at least 10. Grows in place; shrinking is refused at plan.
- `subnet_id` (String) Subnet (sbn_) the warehouse is in. Changing it replaces the warehouse.

### Optional

- `allowed_source_cidrs` (List of String) 1 to 20 IPv4 CIDRs allowed to connect. Left out at create, the VPC's ranges; removing it later keeps the current list.
- `backup_retention_days` (Number) How long backups are kept, 1 to 35 days (7 when left out). Changes in place.
- `backup_window_utc` (String) When the daily backup is taken, HH:MM-HH:MM UTC. Changes in place.
- `backups_enabled` (Boolean) Daily backups of every database. Changes in place.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) While true, neither the warehouse nor its databases can be destroyed.
- `description` (String) Optional description; null clears it.
- `from_backup` (String) Restore this backup into the new warehouse, <warehouse ID>/<backup ID> (a backup's ID is a UUID); shards must equal the backup's shard count (ezgh warehouse backups get shows it), and it needs warehouse.warehouses.query on the backup's warehouse. Its users come across with new passwords in new Secrets (import them to manage them); connections don't. Changing it replaces the warehouse.
- `keeper` (String) Where Keeper runs: dedicated or colocated (3 or more nodes of at least 8 vCPUs and 32 GiB). Null for 1 shard × 1 replica; dedicated when left out on anything larger. Changes in place.
- `maintenance_window_utc` (String) Weekly maintenance window, ddd:HH:MM-ddd:HH:MM UTC. Changes in place.
- `operation_timeout` (String) Maximum wait for each asynchronous operation, for example 60m.
- `plaintext_port` (Boolean) Also serve HTTP on 8123 and the native protocol on 9000 without TLS, inside the VPC. Changes in place.
- `replicas` (Number) Replicas of each shard, 1 to 3 (1 when left out). Each shard keeps serving through the loss of one node with 2 or 3 replicas. More are added in place; fewer are refused at plan.
- `shards` (Number) Shards, 1 to 8 (1 when left out). More shards are added in place: existing data stays on the current shards, and rows inserted through a Distributed table spread across all shards by its sharding key. Fewer are refused at plan.
- `storage_iops` (Number) Each node's provisioned storage IOPS. Set at create.
- `storage_kind` (String) volume. Changing it replaces the warehouse.
- `storage_throughput_mbps` (Number) Each node's provisioned storage throughput in MB/s. Set at create.
- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `app_secret_id` (String) The Secret (sec_) holding the app user's username, password and how to connect.
- `endpoint_hostname` (String) The name clients connect to; null until it resolves. It stays the same through scaling and upgrades.
- `endpoint_https_port` (Number) The HTTPS port, 8443.
- `endpoint_native_port` (Number) The native protocol's TLS port, 9440.
- `endpoint_plaintext_http_port` (Number) 8123 while plaintext_port is true; null otherwise.
- `endpoint_plaintext_native_port` (Number) 9000 while plaintext_port is true; null otherwise.
- `id` (String) Warehouse ID (whs_).
- `operation_id` (String) Most recent operation initiated by this resource; unavailable on import.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `status` (String) What the warehouse is doing.
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC of the subnet.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_warehouse.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/WAREHOUSE_ID'
```
